The science behind Intercept #2

The Princeton research that defined AI citations.

IntentFlow Authority isn't built on opinion — it's built on the peer-reviewed research that defined this field. Here's the science underneath the platform you just saw.

A research team led from Princeton University and IIT Delhi published the peer-reviewed study that defined Generative Engine Optimization — presented at ACM KDD 2024, still the canonical reference in the field. They tested nine content optimization strategies across a 10,000-query benchmark, measured AI citation rates, and identified which signals actually drive AI citations — and which ones backfire. They then validated the methods on Perplexity.ai, a live commercial AI engine, with visibility gains up to 37%. The Authority Institute keeps that methodology current as the AI engines evolve — so your program reflects where AI search is heading, not just where the research began.

From the published study

"GEO can boost visibility by up to 40% in generative engine responses."

The study's strongest finding is who benefits most: the top method lifted AI citation visibility 115.1% for websites ranked fifth in traditional search results, while the average top-ranked site's visibility fell 30.3% as lower-ranked competitors optimized. That is the decoupling insight — AI visibility no longer follows Google rank, and a smaller, smarter competitor can out-cite the incumbent.

What is a search dominance company?

A search dominance company engineers brand presence at the moments that decide buying outcomes across every place buyers search — including Google and Bing autocomplete, and AI answer engines like ChatGPT, Gemini, Perplexity, Claude, and Grok. IntentFlow operates upstream, engineering presence in Google and Bing autocomplete (IntentFlow OSA) and in AI answer citations (IntentFlow Authority). About  ·  The Osinoff Group

Win high-intent demand without outspending incumbents.

We find the intent gaps bigger players overlook, build branded search demand around them, and strengthen your presence across both traditional search and AI-generated answers.

Why We Exist

Most high-demand service markets are still won by brute force — whoever spends the most on ads, bids the highest on every click, and overwhelms the field with budget. That model rewards incumbents and quietly taxes everyone else.

We built IntentFlow around a different belief: in crowded markets, the company that thinks better can still beat the company that spends more. Inside almost every competitive category, there is open ground — high-intent demand that larger players leave unclaimed while they focus on outspending one another. Find that ground, engineer your presence into it, and a challenger can win customers the incumbent assumed were already theirs.

Our Foundation

IntentFlow is powered by The Osinoff Group, LLC and built from operating experience, not agency theory. It came from a career spent building, patenting, and selling companies — and repeatedly solving the same core problem: how a business finds, wins, and grows customers.

Greg Osinoff has founded and exited multiple businesses, built several to eight-figure scale, and developed patented technology and original go-to-market systems along the way. Across those companies, the constant was the same: engineer demand intelligently, outperform bigger budgets, and turn growth into a repeatable system.

Why Buyers Trust It

IntentFlow was never built to sell one person's hours. It was built to turn a proven way of winning into a defined methodology, proprietary technology, and a research function that can operate independent of any single person's time. The expertise is engineered in, not rented.

Its research layer, The Authority Institute, helps keep the method current as Google, Bing, and AI answer engines continue to change. That means IntentFlow is designed to adapt as search behavior shifts from keywords and clicks toward autocomplete, entity signals, and AI-generated answers.

What We Do

IntentFlow engineers branded demand and the signals AI engines learn from, then helps brands earn stronger presence across Google and Bing search and AI engines including ChatGPT, Gemini, Perplexity, Claude, and Grok.

IntentFlow OSA helps engineer high-intent buyers into your branded searches — high-intent traffic positioned below the cost structure of traditional PPC competition. IntentFlow Authority helps brands earn visibility in AI-generated answers through a system informed by emerging GEO research. IntentFlow Intelligent Traffic brings both together with proprietary visitor intelligence so demand can be measured end to end.

Who It Serves

IntentFlow is built for challenger and growth-minded businesses in high-intent, fiercely competitive categories. That includes home services, legal, healthcare, hospitality, insurance, professional services, medical, and SaaS.

What It Solves

IntentFlow helps solve a simple but expensive problem: being outspent at the moment demand forms. As search shifts toward autocomplete and AI answers, we help brands secure presence earlier in the decision journey so a bigger ad budget no longer decides who gets chosen.
